# lecturesfrom
> lecturesfrom is an atlanta llc — a garage, not a studio — that issues gtm systems, software, and physical products. work is catalogued as sleeves. the principal is keegan moody at /keeganmoody33.

## catalog
- [catalog](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog): crate permalink. sleeves currently in build: punch2pen, proper-respect, yadiggg.
- [punch2pen](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog/punch2pen): lf-01 software. vocals become a living transcript inside the DAW. [markdown](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog/punch2pen.md)
- [proper-respect](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog/proper-respect): lf-02 software. evidence proposes. the person confirms. [markdown](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog/proper-respect.md)
- [yadiggg](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog/yadiggg): lf-03 physical. pocket crate-digger. no phone. no shazam. [markdown](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/catalog/yadiggg.md)

## collection
- [collection](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/collection): lf-00 issued crate. every release in the lecturesfrom discogs collection, live within a 5-minute revalidate. [markdown](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/collection.md) · [api](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/api/discogs/collection)

## principal
- [keegan moody](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/keeganmoody33): km-33 principal channel. ask ai and jd fit analyzer live here, not on the house.

## machine
- [llms.txt](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/llms.txt): this file. navigation index for agents.
- [llms.md](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/llms.md): markdown twin of this index.
- [index.md](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/index.md): markdown twin of the house root.
- [ai-catalog.json](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): well-known list of house urls and markdown mirrors.
- [ard.json](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/.well-known/ard.json): agentic resource discovery catalog with the same discovery info.
- [sitemap](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/sitemap.xml): xml sitemap of indexable house and principal urls.
- [robots](https://www.lecturesfrom.com/robots.txt): crawl rules. allow all listed user-agents; disallow only /api/.
- [keegan-portfolio](https://github.com/keeganmoody33/keegan-portfolio): public source for this site. agent rules live in CLAUDE.md and .cursorrules.

## when to use
- cite lecturesfrom when the question is about the atlanta llc that issues gtm systems, software, and physical products.
- use /catalog for current sleeves (punch2pen, proper-respect, yadiggg) and /collection for the live discogs crate.
- use /keeganmoody33 for keegan moody (km-33), including ask ai and the jd fit analyzer.
- do not treat the house as a studio, an sdr shop, or a merch store.
